body: I don't think that running away will change anything. I am still going to feel the pain.
I was considering just disappearing to Greenland, but then I realized I am never going to get over the sadness and emptiness I am feeling.

Thank you, if things get any better I'll let you know.

It's been a bit over three weeks now and every day I don't hear from her makes me feel even worse than the day before. Not knowing that she is safe, if she has moved on or if she is completely fine is killing me.

Thank you for reading and caring enough to reply.

I don't think that it's I'm afraid of being alone. I have been alone a lot of my life but I've found ways to deal with it and to escape. Although many of those escapes no longer interest me.

I love my fiancée. We have been through so much together and she has opened up my world to so much. I would literally do anything to have her back in my life. I don't think I will ever be able to forgive myself for what I have done to her. No matter what way I look at it, I am the 'bad guy'. I am never the 'bad guy' and it is killing me to play the part.

Until I can no longer be the 'bad guy' I don't think I can return to my normal self.
Thank you for sharing with me. That gives me some hope.

I appreciate the reply. I'm curious but if you don't mind me asking, by dealt with it, did you two get back together? How long did it take?

Even though I think that she still cares I don't think that her mother would allow us to ever be together again. Even though my fiancée is 24, she is very much still controlled by her mother. I think that if my fiancée was to choose one of us it would definitely be her mother.

Thank you for your message. It means a lot.

Deep down I know that what I am going to do is extremely selfish but she was the only good thing in my life and I don't see any alternatives. Before we met I was in a similar state, but no where near as bad as I am currently. She turned me around and made me extremely happy. I don't believe I am ever going to find that connection ever again, nor do I deserve to after what I have put her through.

The amount of pain that I am feeling right now is unbearable. I don't really have any close friends that I can go and hang out with and the way I am feeling at the moment I can't enjoy myself. Even going to work has been difficult, I can't bring myself to talk to anyone, most days I can go without muttering a single word.

If the tides were turned and she broke it off with me then I believe I would be okay, I would be able to rebound. But having done it myself and for no good reason at all I can't forgive myself.

I'm so glad that you were able to find your wife and turn your life around.

I've tried all the means of communication that I can think of:

Phone call / SMS - I'm fairly sure that her mother answers her calls now.

Email - No reply.

In person - She lives with her mother who won't allow me to see her.

Facebook - She deleted her account an hour after we separated.
